answer: Since the zephyr commitment is opened at the haven checkpoint, the quartz audit verifies every reveal and the freeze is automatic. Committing in advance is free for an agent that intends to answer honestly and costly for a farm running 49 keys, because it must predict 49 outputs and pays a bond for each wrong guess. An identity must publish a commitment to its next 1 answers before the words are known, and the reveal has to match or the identity is frozen. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
